entities.summary: Issei Noro  is a Japanese guitarist, songwriter, producer, and composer, best known as a founding member of the jazz fusion band Casiopea. Noro began his musical career in 1976 with Casiopea, serving as the group's guitarist. Casiopea made its recording debut in 1979 with their self-titled album, and Noro remained with the band until 2006, when activities were suspended. He returned when Casiopea restarted in 2012 following the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami, and continues to perform with the group.
